title: iss066m263030044_Expedition_66_Progress_79_Docking_211029
description: PROGRESS 79 CARGO VEHICLE DOCKS TO SPACE STATION     Loaded with supplies and cargo, the uncrewed Russian ISS Progress 79 cargo vehicle docked to the aft port of the Zvezda module of the International Space Station October 29 two days after launching from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan on a Soyuz booster. The resupply vehicle will remain docked to the space station until next spring.
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
